verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS website builder, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says Framer's own source is published or openly licensed. Code Components, Code Overrides, plugins and the Server API are developer extension points, not access to the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
